ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to 55% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, roughly elliptical high-intensity white zones located centrally on both the left and right lobes, bordered by continuous low-intensity black margins; the left white zone is bisected by several diagonal low-intensity linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 60 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of roughly 1:1.5.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature of the trailing edges sweeping outwards and upwards toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of small, circular, high-intensity pixel nodes (barnacle colonization) concentrated heavily at the distal tips and along the leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral patches, with the most prominent set occurring diagonally on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring patterns (rake marks) on the ventral surface and significant barnacle encrustation on the fluke extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent dark circular pixel cluster located in the upper-medial region of the right lobe's white patch.
